requiredOutput.concept: Highlight the luxurious and modern lifestyle offered by Sanjeevini Group properties, focusing on architectural elegance and customer satisfaction.
requiredOutput.palette: Use the brand's verified colors, emphasizing a palette that conveys trust and sophistication, such as deep blues and warm neutrals.
requiredOutput.typography: Select a modern sans-serif typeface for body text with a bold serif for headings to convey elegance and readability.

sections.title: Welcome to Sanjeevini Group

sections.visualTreatment: Hero image of a signature property at golden hour.
sections.contentDirection: Brief overview of the company history and core values.

sections.title: Our Projects

sections.contentDirection: Highlight key features and unique selling points of each project.

sections.title: Why Choose Us

sections.contentDirection: Emphasize quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction.

sections.title: Customer Testimonials
sections.purpose: Build trust through verified customer feedback.
sections.visualTreatment: Quotes with customer names and project references.
sections.contentDirection: Use real testimonials from satisfied customers.

sections.title: Contact Us
sections.purpose: Facilitate easy communication with potential clients.
sections.visualTreatment: Simple contact form with a map of the location.
sections.contentDirection: Provide contact details and encourage site visits.

requiredOutput.imageDirection: Use high-resolution, photorealistic images that capture the essence of luxury and modernity in real estate, focusing on lighting and composition to enhance the visual appeal.
requiredOutput.copyRules: Use concise and impactful language that reflects the brand’s professionalism and commitment to quality. Avoid generic or unverified claims.
requiredOutput.factPolicy: Only include facts that are verified through the official website or other reliable sources. Avoid assumptions about client counts or project specifics.
requiredOutput.antiPatterns: Avoid using stock images that do not represent the brand's quality. Refrain from using overly complex layouts that detract from the user experience.

hardRules: Do not invent client counts, years, awards, project names, testimonials, addresses, phone numbers, or statistics.
Do not use internal phrases like generated from brand context or Clear proof cues.
Do not use Discover Luxury Living unless it is explicitly verified brand copy.
Do not use generic section titles if a more specific title can be created from verified context.
Do not use BuildEZ blue/orange defaults unless verified by brand assets.
Do not request vector/illustration/CGI images unless user explicitly asked.

intent.audience: buyers comparing properties and booking site visits
intent.imageStyle: architectural photography, premium interiors, golden hour exterior, spacious modern property

requiredOutput.concept: Modern and sophisticated design reflecting Sanjeevini Group's commitment to quality and innovation.
requiredOutput.palette: Use deep blues and warm golds reflecting the brand's logo and identity.
requiredOutput.typography: Elegant and readable typeface with a clear hierarchy, using serif fonts for headings and sans-serif for body text.
requiredOutput.layoutSystem: Clean and structured layout with clear sections for projects, testimonials, and contact information. Responsive grid for mobile adaptability.

sections.title: Welcome to Sanjeevini Group
sections.purpose: Introduce the brand and its core values.
sections.visualTreatment: Hero image of a Sanjeevini project at golden hour.

sections.title: Our Projects
sections.visualTreatment: High-quality images of properties with project descriptions.
sections.contentDirection: Details about each project, including location and features.

sections.title: Customer Testimonials
sections.visualTreatment: Images of happy homeowners with quotes.

sections.title: About Us
sections.contentDirection: History, mission, and vision of Sanjeevini Group.

sections.title: Why Choose Us
sections.visualTreatment: Infographic style presentation of unique selling points.
sections.contentDirection: Highlight the use of technology, customer-centric approach, and quality assurance.

sections.title: Contact Us
sections.contentDirection: Phone number, email, and office address.

requiredOutput.imageDirection: Use high-resolution, photorealistic images focusing on architectural details and lifestyle settings.
requiredOutput.copyRules: Use clear, concise language that conveys trust and quality. Avoid hyperbolic claims and generic phrases.
requiredOutput.factPolicy: Only use verified facts from the brand's website. Do not invent any statistics or client testimonials.
requiredOutput.antiPatterns: Avoid using overly bright colors or cluttered layouts that detract from the brand's premium image.

hardRules: Do not invent client counts, years, awards, project names, testimonials, addresses, phone numbers, or statistics.
Do not use internal phrases like generated from brand context or Clear proof cues.
Do not use Discover Luxury Living unless it is explicitly verified brand copy.
Do not use generic section titles if a more specific title can be created from verified context.
Do not use BuildEZ blue/orange defaults unless verified by brand assets.
Do not request vector/illustration/CGI images unless user explicitly asked.
